purpose: Advance NRG4YOU using a new public-authority Restation tariff surface without extrapolation.

newEvidence: Comune di Argenta documents customer.restation.eu/stations as the charging/payment surface for four municipal 22 kW stations and publishes a current service price of 0.25 EUR/kWh, with service guaranteed through 2028.

Current public references independently identify customer.restation.eu/stations as the NRG4YOU network surface; Vietri sul Mare municipal/tourism material maps NRG4YOU Corso Umberto I to that surface and describes two paid Type 2 22 kW sockets.

A third-party Electromaps record reports 0.60 EUR/kWh for NRG4YOU Corso Umberto in Vietri, last updated 2025-05-30; retained only as a discovery candidate because current first-party/public-authority numeric confirmation is absent.
investigated.tariffChannel: Restation customer payment surface; public-authority tariff where explicitly published
investigated.positiveProof: The Argenta case proves that the Restation surface can carry a deterministic site/program tariff and that NRG-labelled/Restation-hosted inventory must be resolved station/program by station/program rather than assigned an NRG-wide value.
negativePaths: Do not extrapolate Argenta 0.25 EUR/kWh outside the four municipal Argenta stations.
Do not promote Vietri 0.60 EUR/kWh from Electromaps without current direct/public-authority confirmation.
Do not use generic Italian AC/DC averages or roaming eMSP prices as NRG4YOU direct tariffs.
investigated.blocker: Exact PUN NRG EVSE -> Restation station/program crosswalk is not yet recovered for Argenta or the wider NRG inventory, so no canonical EVSE can safely receive the 0.25 EUR/kWh tariff yet.
investigated.resumeCondition: Recover Restation station IDs/API payload or exact PUN EVSE identities for the four Argenta municipal sites, then promote only the matched subpopulation; continue the same crosswalk for other NRG stations.
investigated.confidence: high on station/program model and Argenta numeric tariff; fail-closed on EVSE mapping

next: NRG Argenta exact PUN EVSE/Restation crosswalk
